skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json success
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id one --wait
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --metadata-only --ack-unverified-terminal --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
skygo --json jobs retention
json-value admin.obligations.0.id OBLIGATION
usage OUTPUT_BYTES BEFORE
positive-env BEFORE
! stdout 'must-not-appear'
output-permission deny
skygo --json jobs prune --logs-only --obligation $OBLIGATION --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
skygo --json jobs retention
usage CLEANUP_RECORDS PENDING
positive-env PENDING
await-remove-failure
skygo --json jobs retention
usage OUTPUT_BYTES FAILED
equal-env BEFORE FAILED
usage CLEANUP_RECORDS FAILED_RECORDS
equal-env PENDING FAILED_RECORDS
stdout '"output_pending": *true'
assert-native 0
output-permission restore
await-output-usage 0
skygo --json jobs retention
stdout '"needs_manual": *true'
usage CLEANUP_RECORDS FINAL_RECORDS
env HEADER_CHARGE=1
equal-env FINAL_RECORDS HEADER_CHARGE
! stdout '"output_pending": *true'
assert-native 0
